entities.summary: Heinrich Friedrich Albert was a German civil servant, diplomat, politician, businessman and lawyer who served as minister for reconstruction and the Treasury in the government of Wilhelm Cuno in 1922/1923. During his tenure as commercial attaché to the German embassy to the U.S. in 1914–17, he was suspected of engaging in espionage and sabotage.
